Name: Bow Riser/Handle
Description: Main structural body with ergonomic grip, incorporating attachment points for limbs and accessories.

Name: Upper Bow Limb
Description: Upper flexible limb, designed for composite printing with embedded fiber for strength and flex.

Name: Lower Bow Limb
Description: Lower flexible limb, designed for composite printing with embedded fiber for strength and flex.

Name: Upper Binary Cam
Description: Upper cam for the binary cam system, includes string channels.

Name: Lower Binary Cam
Description: Lower cam for the binary cam system, includes string channels.

Name: Upper Cam Axle
Description: Shaft for upper cam rotation.

Name: Lower Cam Axle
Description: Shaft for lower cam rotation.

Name: Upper Cam Inner Bearing
Description: Ball bearing for smooth rotation of the upper cam.

Name: Upper Cam Outer Bearing
Description: Ball bearing for smooth rotation of the upper cam.

Name: Lower Cam Inner Bearing
Description: Ball bearing for smooth rotation of the lower cam.

Name: Lower Cam Outer Bearing
Description: Ball bearing for smooth rotation of the lower cam.

Name: Bowstring
Description: Main string for propelling the arrow.

Name: Control Cable
Description: Cable connecting cams and regulating draw length/let-off.

Name: Buss Cable
Description: Cable connecting cams and managing limb tension.

Name: 3D Printed Arrow Rest
Description: Support for the arrow before release.

Name: 3D Printed Nocking Point
Description: Small clip-on part to define arrow nock position on the string.

Name: Limb Attachment Bolt
Description: Bolt for securing bow limbs to the riser.

Name: Limb Attachment Nut
Description: Locking nut for securing limb attachment bolts.

Name: Accessory Threaded Insert
Description: Threaded insert for mounting accessories like arrow rest, sight, stabilizer.

Name: Arrow Rest Mounting Bolt
Description: Bolt for securing the 3D printed arrow rest to the riser.
